subject: Exec workshop onsite — finalizing badging & site entry protocols
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec workshop onsite — badging & entry requirements

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for hosting our executive workshop on March 3–4. We want to confirm logistics on the Redwood side so there are no surprises when the team arrives. Quick summary and asks: 

- Attendees (first+last name + photo ID): Marissa Cole (RDW), Stephanie Nguyen (RDW), Vivek Kulkarni (RDW), Dev Patel (RDW), plus one guest for site ops.
- Arrival window: March 3, 08:30–09:00 — working lunch planned for 12:30.
- Badging: Do we need names uploaded to a vendor portal in advance, or will on-site badges be printed? Any template we should fill out?
- Escort: Is a building escort required at all times? If so, can you confirm escort contact?
- Laptops / devices: Please confirm if external USB drives or personal devices require prior authorization or AV inspection.
- Parking & access: Number of visitor parking spaces available and instructions for permits.
- Emergency contact / muster point and any site safety forms attendees must sign.

Attached is a draft Visitor_Badge_Form we use internally — feel free to tell us if you need a different format.

If there are any specific security clearances or additional paperwork (e.g., NDA, SC access), let us know and we’ll route to legal immediately. Our team can complete a portal upload or DocuSign if that’s easier.

Would appreciate the reply by Monday so we can collect IDs.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: Visitor_Badge_Form.pdf
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme-finance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Financial Visitor Desk <visitors@acme-finance.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop onsite — badging & entry requirements

Hi Marissa,

Great to hear — we look forward to hosting Redwood. A few items to flag for your team (please share with attendees):

1) Badging / portal: We require all external visitors to complete the vendor portal visit request. I can pre-create a batch for your group if you email me full legal names and government ID numbers (passport or driver’s license). We will then print badges at security.

2) Escort policy: For Building B (where the exec meeting will be), an escort is required in secure zones between 08:00–17:30. The escort will meet at the lobby desk.

3) Device policy: Personal laptops are allowed but must have disk-encryption enabled. External removable media (USB drives) are not allowed unless pre-cleared — we can arrange a scanned/isolated laptop if needed.

4) Parking & entry: We can reserve 3 visitor parking permits near the south entrance; please confirm license plates on arrival day. Any vehicles that require overnight parking need pre-approval.

5) Safety & compliance: Please review the attached Site_Entry_Policy.pdf. Our legal team requires a signed site safety acknowledgment for every visitor; a DocuSign link will be sent when you submit the portal request.

Deadline: Please submit the required names/IDs and the signed acknowledgment by Feb 20 to avoid blocked access.

Visitor desk contact: visitors@acme-finance.com / +1 212-555-2468

Best,

Laura Jensen
Facilities & Security Manager | Acme Financial
laura.jensen@acme-finance.com

Attachment: Site_Entry_Policy.pdf
